comparator.name: International Business Administration
comparator.sourceNotes: Tilburg's current official curriculum, checked 2026-09-29, publishes fixed 60-ECTS first and second years. Year 3 preserves a 30-ECTS mobility window with four approved options, followed by 30 ECTS of compulsory strategy, international business and economics, corporate law, global ethics and thesis work. The generic bachelor does not designate one mobility option as the representative route, so that structured choice remains one 30-ECTS component rather than being instantiated for UCR fit. Zero-credit GROW student-development activities are excluded from the credited reconstruction. The listed components total exactly 180 ECTS.
components: Human Resource Management of International Business
Comparative and Cross-Cultural Management for IBA
Decision Making in Marketing for IBA
Mobility Window: one approved exchange, internship or minor option
One 30-ECTS option is required from exchange/study abroad, a 24-ECTS internship plus 6-ECTS elective, two 15-ECTS Economics and Management minors, or another Tilburg minor.
Compulsory independent bachelor thesis on a business-related topic.

alternatives.label: International business, management & entrepreneurship
alternatives.concept: A broad closest feasible international-business programme combining global strategy, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, organisational behaviour and governance with accounting, finance, economics, research, data, technology and business law.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum combines international business and management with entrepreneurship, economics, finance, marketing, data, law and leadership; the label therefore names its broad business composition.
progression: Business, economics, data and research foundations precede advanced strategy, law, leadership, econometrics and market research. All formal prerequisites occur earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.
traceOverrides: examines managerial and organisational implications of AI and technological change within a broad international-business curriculum
introduces machine-learning models for evidence-based analysis within the programme's data and technology strand
develops microeconomic and behavioural analysis of consumer and firm decisions

alternatives.label: Business, AI & digital transformation
alternatives.concept: An international-business direction organised around analytics, artificial intelligence and digital transformation, combining programming, machine learning and deep learning with strategy, organisations, marketing, finance and responsible technology.
alternatives.labelReason: The curriculum retains a substantial business core while adding a sequenced programming, mathematics, data, algorithms and AI strand, so the label names both business and AI.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the broad closest match, this route replaces much of the general economics, law, communication and leadership mix with programming, mathematics, algorithms, databases, machine learning, deep learning and AI ethics.
progression: Business, programming, data, research and mathematical foundations precede advanced strategy, algorithms, machine learning, deep learning, international business and market research. Mathematical Methods precedes linear algebra, probability and deep learning; programming precedes algorithms. All formal prerequisites occur earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

alternatives.label: Finance, accounting & global business
alternatives.concept: An international-business direction centred on accounting, finance and analytical decision-making, combining corporate finance, banking, economics and econometrics with probability, data science, programming and global governance.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum is organised around finance and accounting but also contains economics, quantitative analysis, strategy and international governance, so the label includes global business.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the closest match and the AI route, this curriculum gives greater weight to finance, banking, accounting, economics, econometrics, probability and behavioural decision-making while retaining an international-business foundation.
progression: Business, economics, programming, data, research and mathematical foundations precede public economics, international business, probability, machine learning, econometrics, behavioural economics and finance. Mathematical Methods precedes linear algebra and probability; Business Foundations precedes Money, Banking & Finance and International Business & Governance. All formal prerequisites occur earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

selection.assessment: The broad closest match accounts for the programme's general international strategy, culture, management, governance, marketing, supply-chain, leadership, sustainability and ethics interests. Two generator-backed directions remain coherent and feasible: business analytics and emerging technology, and international finance and accounting. Their completed curricula are pairwise distinct by well over the 30-ECTS floor, so production reaches the maximum of three alternatives.

notes.text: Tilburg's IBA provides a dense compulsory sequence across international business functions, including supply chains, human-resource management, management accounting, cross-cultural management, corporate governance and a required business thesis. UCR can build coherent international-business, technology and finance programmes, but it does not reproduce the same complete functional sequence or required thesis.
